answer.rationale: With contract expiry in 14 days and the line already at 94% of committed volume, continuity risk dominates. The incumbent's refusal to reopen price means renewal will not satisfy the spend mandate on price alone, but switching primary supply now would introduce unverified delivery and qualification risk at a time with no operating buffer. Verify the prior record of incumbent delivery stability before committing, while treating the 18% savings gap as a material unresolved constraint for the next sourcing review.
